1. Infosys maintained margins at 21% in FY26 and H1 FY27, despite investments in sales, AI talent, and technology [T1 p.35].
2. Acquisitions impact margins by 50 bps as a full-year headwind [T1 p.35].
3. H2 headwinds include wage hikes (October and January), acquisition-related amortization, and seasonally slower periods, partially offset by Project Maximus [T1 p.35].
4. AI projects generally have better pricing and margins due to premium talent costs [T3 p.37].
5. Margin discipline is maintained by declining contracts that fail economic guidelines [T1 p.19].
